country: International (US, Europe, Asia; prospective trial at a single US cancer center)
models_evaluated: Fine-tuned open-source pathology foundation model for EGFR mutation prediction

links.outcome: Prospective silent-trial performance of EGFR biomarker on live primary samples (AUC)
links.effect: Prospective silent trial on primary samples achieved AUC of 0.890, consistent with retrospective internal 0.847 and external 0.870 performance.
links.quote: To evaluate real-world clinical translation, we conducted a prospective silent trial of the biomarker on primary samples, achieving an area under the curve of 0.890.

links.outcome: Performance on internal versus external out-of-center validation data (AUC)
links.effect: Mean AUC internal 0.847, external 0.870, showing out-of-center generalization with clinical-grade accuracy on primary and metastatic specimens.
links.quote: Our model fine-tunes an open-source foundation model, improving task-specific performance with out-of-center generalization and clinical-grade accuracy on primary and metastatic specimens (mean area under the curve: internal 0.847, external 0.870).

unlisted_practices: Using AI-based computational biomarker as a triage to reduce rapid molecular tests while preserving tissue and clinical-standard performance

screen.reason: The study evaluates a pathology foundation model for lung cancer biomarker detection via a prospective silent trial deployment integrated into the clinical workflow, demonstrating a reduction in unnecessary rapid molecular testing.
